stories.headline: Goat Simulator 3 launches Ticket to Dizzyworld theme-park expansion
stories.summary: Coffee Stain North released Ticket to Dizzyworld for Goat Simulator 3 on PC and consoles. The expansion adds a theme-park map with 24 events, eight playable goats, 77 gear pieces, rideable attractions and Dizzy Tokens to spend on rewards. The expansion requires the base game.

stories.headline: Baldur's Gate 3 reveals Shadowheart prequel novel
stories.summary: An official Baldur's Gate 3 novel focused on Shadowheart is in development, written by fantasy author Tasha Suri. The story explores Shadowheart's past within the Church of Shar through a mystery involving fellow initiate Nocturne. A publication date has not been confirmed.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever designer explains a move away from universal best-in-slot gear
stories.summary: Senior item designer Aidan Moon says World of Warcraft: Forever aims to make equipment choices more situational. Bonuses tied to environments and creature subtypes could reward players for preparing different gear sets for different encounters, rather than relying on one universally optimal setup.

stories.headline: Steam schedules a Black Friday deals hub for November 26 to 30
stories.summary: Valve says Steam will not run an official platform-wide Black Friday Fest. Instead, its Discounts & Events page will highlight eligible discounts from November 26 through November 30. The promotion is separate from the Steam Winter Sale, which begins December 17.

stories.headline: GTA 6 reportedly accounted for nearly a quarter of Comcast traffic at launch
stories.summary: Comcast says network traffic on the November 19 launch day for Grand Theft Auto VI was 31% above its typical level. At peak, game-related downloads made up nearly one-quarter of traffic on Comcast's own network. The figures do not refer to global internet traffic.

stories.headline: Wizards of the Coast gives D&D writers its share of AI copyright settlement
stories.summary: Wizards of the Coast says it will pass its portion of a copyright settlement involving AI company Anthropic to the affected Dungeons & Dragons writers, rather than retaining a publisher share. The decision follows a settlement over the use of books in AI training.

stories.headline: Warframe Black Friday sale cuts PC bundle prices by up to 50% through November 30
stories.summary: Digital Extremes is discounting selected Warframe premium bundles and TennoGen cosmetics on PC and Steam. The Starter Weapon Pack is 50% off, the Constellations Complete Collection is 20% off, and several retiring packs have discounts. The PC sale ends November 30 at 17:00.

stories.headline: The Road of Dust and Sorrow's free PC demo showcases atmospheric pixel-art horror
stories.summary: A new PC Gamer hands-on spotlights The Road of Dust and Sorrow's playable Steam demo. The 1990s-inspired side-scrolling horror adventure follows a mother protecting her daughter through a monster-filled wasteland, combining scavenging, combat and puzzles. Steam currently lists February 19, 2027 as its planned release date.

stories.headline: Atari E.T. designer compares AI-game flood to the market glut before the 1983 crash
stories.summary: At a DevGAMM Lisbon talk, former Atari developer Howard Scott Warshaw compared the surge of AI-assisted game creation to the low-quality oversupply that preceded the 1983 US videogame crash. He said he does not expect another crash, arguing better discovery filters will be needed while AI also gives inventive developers new opportunities.
